task.name: Start_Zimmer_vaporizer
task.when: When the licensed Flame Lead authorizes flame-effect startup after a passed daily inspection

step.action: Confirm that every effect feed valve is closed.
Confirm that the release quarter-turn valve is in the closed position shown in 🔥 Flame_Effect_Operating_Procedure.
Inspect the vaporizer guard and relief-valve outlet for damage, obstruction, or playa dust.
step.ifThen: IF the guard is damaged or the relief path is obstructed, THEN do not start the vaporizer.

step.action: Energize the vaporizer using the control named in 🔥 Flame_Effect_Operating_Procedure.

step.ifThen: IF the voltage is outside the approved range printed in 🔥 Flame_Effect_Operating_Procedure, THEN de-energize the vaporizer and stop.

step.action: Wait until every thermocouple reaches the approved operating range printed in 🔥 Flame_Effect_Operating_Procedure.
Slowly open the liquid-tank valve identified in 🔥 Flame_Effect_Operating_Procedure.
Leak-test the energized vaporizer connections with 🔥 Propane_Leak_Test_Solution according to the approved procedure.
step.ifThen: IF growing bubbles, propane odor, hissing, frost, or an abnormal reading is present, THEN complete the approved emergency shutdown and keep the system out of service.

passWhen.criterion: The vaporizer voltage and every thermocouple are in their approved ranges.
The liquid supply is open and no leak or abnormal reading is present.

reasoning.entry: System-specific ranges and control names are not guessed; the Flame Lead-approved operating procedure must supply them.
